snippet.title: Elderfeast - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
👇Wishlist on Steam 👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4393700/Elderfeast?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=revealtrailer

Elderfeast is a cooperative action game from Lurker Entertainment where the monsters are the menu. Hunt Lovecraftian-inspired horrors across the galaxy, carving them apart for ingredients to inspire your next meal. The better you cook, the stronger you become, but there's always something more terrifying to hunt next.

🧑‍🍳 Become a Void Chef:
